item.title: Claude Code Best Practices Cheatsheet
item.description:
Simple definition#

Claude Code’s defaults already do the right thing for most prompts: auto mode, Opus 5.5 at medium effort, automatic sub-agents and automatic compaction. Best practice is mostly about the few things no default can know — what is not in your repo, how to check the work, which rules can never bend, and what you are willing to spend.

item.title: Using Claude Intelligently
item.description:
Simple definition#

Using Claude intelligently means getting reliable, verified results at the lowest sensible cost and risk. It rests on five habits: give the right context, ask for a clear outcome, make the result verifiable, pick the right model and effort, and keep a human accountable for what ships.
